title: Finite H-Tilt Shift Bridge
summary: A Lean-verified algebraic bridge from a generator-style operator K to the discrete shifted operator A = cI + K. The bridge proves shifted left/right eigenmode identities, the exact Doob-kernel relation D^{cI+K} = I + L-tilde^K/(c+lambda), and entrywise nonnegativity of the shifted operator under explicit off-diagonal and diagonal-shift hypotheses.

proves: Eigenmode shift under A = cI + K.
Exact algebraic relation between the discrete Doob kernel of A and the generator-style Doob transform of K.
Entrywise nonnegativity of A under explicit off-diagonal and diagonal-shift hypotheses.
does_not_prove: That c can always be chosen unless an explicit existence theorem is separately proved.
